# Owned result-screen descriptor tables

Static File #1 US o2 base570000; SHA256 `45360a971e88878312576abaebd1a7b8346f7e94cc032adde9172343f14e6226`. Complete bounded byte intervals referenced by reviewed result renderers. Values decode as signed half atlas index, signed bytes kind/Ureverse, then four signed geometry halves. Overlapping spans are retained as distinct caller reads; this is not a declaration of original C array boundaries. No target execution or asset decompression.
